run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the longest repeating non-overlapping substring in a given string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings to verify correct longest repeating substring output
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming approach using an LCS table to find non-overlapping repeated substrings
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a 2D DP table to find the longest repeating non-overlapping substring
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the O(n^2) space DP table with a more memory-efficient approach
